subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar o presente contínuo para descrever ações em progresso.

components.description_pt: Formar tempos verbais progressivos usando verbos auxiliares corretos e gerúndios
components.description_en: Form progressive verb tenses using correct helping verbs and present participles
components.cc_component_description: Form progressive verb tenses using correct helping verbs and present participles

components.description_pt: Descrever ações em progresso usando o tempo presente contínuo
components.description_en: Describe actions currently in progress using the present continuous tense
components.cc_component_description: Use present-tense verbs correctly to describe current actions in writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir contextos que exigem presente contínuo daqueles que exigem presente simples
components.description_en: Distinguish contexts requiring the present continuous tense from those requiring simple present
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between contexts that require formal English and those appropriate for informal discourse

cc_matches.description: Form and use the progressive (e.g., I was walking; I am walking; I will be walking) verb tenses.
Use verbs to convey a sense of past, present, and future (e.g., Yesterday I walked home; Today I walk home; Tomorrow I will walk home).

Differentiate between contexts that call for formal English (e.g., presenting ideas) and situations where informal discourse is appropriate (e.g., small-group discussion); use formal English when appropriate to task and situation.
